Theories of Learning: Classical Conditioning (Pavlov), Operant Conditioning (Skinner - Reinforcement Theory), Social Learning Theory (Bandura)
Perception: Meaning, Perceptual Process (Selection, Organization, Interpretation)
Factors Influencing Perception & Perceptual Distortions: Stereotyping, Halo Effect, Contrast Effect, Projection, Selective Perception
Attitudes: Components of Attitude (ABC Model - Affective, Behavioral, Cognitive)
Workplace Attitudes: Job Satisfaction, Job Involvement, Organizational Commitment, Cognitive Dissonance Theory (Leon Festinger)
